text: Hello, I'm really sorry to be messaging at this time of night and I know you must have much more serious things to deal with, so please feel free to tell me if this is a waste of your time. I'm a childminder and I have a 7 year old girl staying with me for a couple of nights while her parents are away for a family thing. Since yesterday she's had a runny, blocked up nose and she's been sneezing loads, the usual cold sort of thing I think. The other thing is she hasn't been for a poo for three days now. She's quite grumpy about it, says her tummy feels full and she's fed up of sitting on the toilet with nothing happening. I've been giving her water and some fruit but I wasn't sure if there's anything else I should be doing, or if it's something that needs looking at, or whether to just wait until her mum is back. I don't want to give her anything without checking first because she's not my own. Sorry again and thank you for reading all this.
